planets.name: TOI-270 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-270 with a 3.36-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: TOI-270 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-270. Its orbit and size follow Kaye et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
